description: Lists messages in a space (including messages from blocked members and spaces): name, text, sender, createTime, thread.name, attachment metadata and emoji reaction summaries. Filters are the API's only two: created_after (createTime) and thread_name (one thread's messages) — there is no text search, match client-side. order defaults to ascending by createTime; show_deleted includes tombstones of deleted messages. Poll incrementally with created_after + page_token instead of re-listing history. Requires the chat.messages.readonly (or chat.messages) scope and works only with user authentication.

created_after.description: Only messages created after this RFC3339 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.

space.description: The space — "spaces/<id>" or the bare id from list_spaces / a Chat URL (chat.google.com/room/<id>).

thread_name.description: Only messages in this thread (thread.name from a message).

name: list_messages
title: List messages
